name: project-template
description: UI-only project template for static React apps

scripts.synth: pnpm --filter infra exec cdk synth --profile DRoemhildt19
scripts.diff: pnpm --filter infra exec cdk diff --profile DRoemhildt19
scripts.deploy: pnpm --filter infra exec cdk deploy --profile DRoemhildt19 --require-approval never
scripts.github-action-deploy: biome check . && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter infra exec cdk deploy --require-approval never
